opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petitions for writs of certiorari are granted, the judgments of the courts below are vacated, and the cases *203are remanded for further consideration in the light of Marchetti v. United, States, ante, p. 39.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.
